title: SFV2 Switching a Work Orders setting writes no history entry, because nothing changes
expected:
1. Switching a setting on the Work Orders settings page on or off changes no record that already exists: "No record is changed by this switch. Parts already on a work order keep the state they are in."

2. Because no record is changed, no entry is written to a work order's Audit Log for the switch itself - there is nothing to attribute and no cause to name.

3. The Audit Log still records everything a person does on the work order, exactly as before.

Source:

  • QA lead ruling, 25 September 2026 - the confirmation the product itself shows when a Work Orders setting is switched is the expected behaviour: "No record is changed by this switch. Parts already on a work order keep the state they are in."
  • Epic SV-8683, story SV-9248 (Story 2, Settings apply to every work order), Simple Flow V2 specification (Confluence page 771391574).

Last checked against build v26.39.0-07c719b on 9/25/2026.
